{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Remove duplicates by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the new shape
print("New dataframe shape:", trial_df.shape)

# Display the first few rows to confirm
trial_df.head()"}
